Monument Ridge Elementary School parents:  Child Evangelism Fellowship has a free "Good News Club" that meets at Monument Ridge after school every Tuesday (4-5:30pm) on school days.  This is a basic non-denominational Bible club for K-5th.  We have games, snacks, stories, music.  Children who are not from Monument Ridge are welcome to attend as well. Parents are welcome to join, or children can be dropped off. Registration papers can be picked up at the school office, or scan the QR code below to register.
